theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar (0.85), perfect breadth (1.0), and a 'trend' hurst tag among eligible names — the strongest staying-power profile in the detector. theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The rank-1 leader shows val_state 'fading', a mixed hurst tag, and modest breadth (0.708) — leadership without the texture of durability. Per guardrails, this is not a momentum buy and not a fade on crowding (it is NOT crowded); the honest read is to avoid adding on a fading, non-trend leader.
